items.title: Walter Nelson Interview, 1960-10-06
items.q: he would go out and play with Punch

ctx.x: did he ever talk about his life to you?

only thing he used to tell me he would go out and play with Punch mm-hmm cause I don't remember when Punch came and I think he came from Racely yeah him and my uncle was together yeah he played with Grenier Sam Morgan I know that he told me once he was playing with Guy Kelly I don't know something like that yeah
Guy Kelly I think came from Baton Rouge up the river did he uh when you knew him did he usually play guitar or banjo?
